description: This Kotlin source file defines the 'DetailsViewModel' class for an Android app. The class manages the state and behavior of the recipe details screen, including loading recipe data and toggling favorite status.

classes.name: DetailsViewModel
classes.description: AndroidViewModel subclass managing UI data for recipe details, including loading recipes and toggling favorite status.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a recipe by its ID and updates LiveData properties with the recipe and favorite status.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status for the current recipe, updating the FavoriteStore and LiveData accordingly.
